_comment: Single source for every CV. /hunt-onboard phase 2 drafts it from the originals in sources/; nothing here is usable until its claims are confirmed in collateral/claim-bank.md. Every text unit carries claim IDs. Variants (collateral/cv/variants/*.json) and tailored CVs (data/applications/<id>/cv/<slug>.json) only pick and order these units; they never add wording. person mirrors profile/person.json for the CV header and footer. Bullet keys are <role-key>-<topic>. A role shown in full needs contexts.default; a role shown inline among earlier roles needs line. titles, contexts and subheads are optional alternates, picked by key from a variant. Optional layout fields: links {"<company or product name>": "<url>"} makes each name clickable on the CV; employers {<key>: {name, dates, claims}} plus a role's "via": "<key>" prints a client engagement as "Client (via Employer)"; a role's clients [{name, claims}] lists featured clients for a variant's practice section; education[].note prints after the degree. A variant may add practice {role, context, items, clients: true, heading} (a section after Experience, default heading "Independent Practice") and contact {location, workplace: null, phone: "profile" | null} (phone shows profile/person.json's number; the default is person.json show_phone_on_cv). Build: npm run cv -- --all.

<role-key>-<topic>.text: <one achievement line in the claim's wording>

<title-key>.text: <alternate title for this role, if the operator held it>

default.text: <one line on what the company does and the remit of the role>

line.text: <one-line summary, used when the role is shown inline among earlier roles>
